"""Bounded metadata re-export; retain the completed calculation's exact bytes."""
import csv,io,json,os,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
r=Path.cwd();p=r/'.temp/hybrid-e-r17-261104';sys.path.insert(0,str(r/'calc'))
from run23 import export
out=export.OUT;old=json.loads((out/'r23_manifest.json').read_text())
assert old['base']==export.BASE and old['generator']==export.generator_identity()
assert old['extension']==json.loads((p/'source-identity-final.json').read_text())
assert all(export.digest((out/name).read_bytes())==digest for name,digest in old['files'].items())
current=export.source_identity();different={k for k in set(current)|set(old['extension'])if current.get(k)!=old['extension'].get(k)}
assert different=={'calc/run23/export.py','calc/tests/test_run23.py'},different
before=export.read(out/'mac_direct_measurements.csv')
raw=list(export.engine.night.mac_rows().values())
new=export.csv_bytes(export.publishable_tables({'mac_direct_measurements':raw})['mac_direct_measurements'])
after=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(new.decode())))
# Every original cell, including all numeric strings, survives unchanged. Only
# the native disposition column is added and the duplicate health header removed.
stripped=[{k:v for k,v in row.items()if k!='measurement_status'}for row in after]
assert stripped==before,'original measurement cells changed'
assert len(after)==6 and after[-1]['measurement_status']=='refused_context'
schema=json.loads((out/'r23_schema.json').read_text());mac=schema['mac_direct_measurements']
mac['columns']=['measurement_status'if k=='status'else k for k in mac['columns']]
mac['units']['measurement_status']=mac['units'].pop('status')
payload={'mac_direct_measurements.csv':new,'r23_schema.json':export.encoded(schema)}
manifest=dict(old);manifest['extension']=current
manifest['metadata_reexport']=dict(reason='native benchmark disposition separated from generic export-health status; no mathematical source/data or original calculation cell changed',
    calculation_manifest_sha256=export.digest((out/'r23_manifest.json').read_bytes()),calculation_extension=old['extension'],
    preserved_files={n:h for n,h in old['files'].items()if n not in payload},mac_cells_sha256=export.digest(export.encoded(before)),
    original_rows=len(before),original_cells_preserved=sum(len(row)for row in before))
manifest['files']=dict(old['files'],**{n:export.digest(v)for n,v in payload.items()})
payload['r23_manifest.json']=export.encoded(manifest)
(p/'calculation-manifest-before-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(old,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.r23-label-',dir=out)as temporary:
 for name,value in payload.items():(Path(temporary)/name).write_bytes(value)
 for name in payload:os.replace(Path(temporary)/name,out/name)
records=export.quote_records()
with export.LEDGER.open('w',newline='')as f:
 writer=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(records[0]),lineterminator='\n');writer.writeheader();writer.writerows(records)
(p/'source-identity-calculation.json').write_text((p/'source-identity-final.json').read_text())
(p/'source-identity-final.json').write_text(json.dumps(current,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(export.verify(),mathematical_sources_unchanged=True,preserved_payloads=len(manifest['metadata_reexport']['preserved_files']),original_mac_cells_preserved=manifest['metadata_reexport']['original_cells_preserved']),sort_keys=True))
